name: assetfy
description: Site checks and land acquisition for German real estate: parcels on the cadastral map, Bebauungsplan, Bodenrichtwert, GRZ/GFZ, building heights and property listings.

interface.longDescription:
Site checks and land acquisition for brokers, project developers, homebuilders, architects, valuers and institutional investors who want to buy or appraise a property in Germany.

Ask in plain language about a Flurstück, an address or a current listing. The answer comes from the official cadastre (ALKIS), 3D building models (LoD2), Bodenrichtwerte (BORIS), aerial images and Bebauungspläne where available.

What Assetfy provides:
- Flurstück and cadastral map: Gemarkung, Flur, Flurstücksnummer, plot size in m², outline, shape, street frontage and location
- Buildings: address, building function, number of storeys, building height, Traufhöhe, Firsthöhe, roof shape, year of construction, footprint
- Actual land use from the cadastre, e.g. residential, commercial and industrial land, storage, agriculture, railway land
- Planning law and an indicative first assessment of building potential: Bebauungsplan with plan documents, §34/§35 BauGB, GRZ, GFZ, BGF (gross floor area), densification and extension potential
- Bodenrichtwert and land value (BORIS)
- Aerial image: official orthophoto (DOP20) for every site
- Property listings: plots, houses, apartments, commercial properties and foreclosure auctions
- Site search for commercial, logistics, data centres, battery storage and solar parks by use, size, building coverage, Bebauungsplan and motorway access in one step (depending on the account)

Read-only: the plugin never changes or adds anything, neither in Assetfy nor in the user's account.

Limitations: coverage is Germany. Bebauungsplan data is not available in every state or municipality, and the result says so where it is missing. Building potential is an indicative first assessment, not a legal opinion or a building permit.

Sign in with your Assetfy account to connect.
defaultPrompt: What may be built on the plot at Am Mittelhafen 11, 48155 Münster?
Show me the Bodenrichtwert and the Bebauungsplan for my address.
How tall are the buildings on this plot? I need Traufhöhe and Firsthöhe.

positive.description: Parcel profile for a street address
positive.prompt: Create the parcel profile for Am Mittelhafen 11, 48155 Münster: Flurstück, plot size, buildings and Bodenrichtwert.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Flurstück 732, Flur 148, Gemarkung Münster with 14,706 m², the six buildings on the parcel and the Bodenrichtwert of 595 €/m² (Stichtag 01.01.2026, zone Hafen), each fact cited as Assetfy data, plus an assetfy_url link to the parcel on the Assetfy map.

positive.prompt: Which Bebauungsplan applies to Am Mittelhafen 11, 48155 Münster? Summarise what its textliche Festsetzungen say about the permitted use.
positive.expected_behavior: Names Bebauungsplan Nr. 401 'Stadthafen I / Albersloher Weg' (in force since 08.11.1996), reads the textliche Festsetzungen and summarises the rules on permitted use, marked as an indicative first assessment.

positive.description: Buildings with eaves and ridge height
positive.prompt: How tall are the buildings on the plot at Am Mittelhafen 11, 48155 Münster? I need Traufhöhe and Firsthöhe.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the six buildings on the parcel with building function, roof shape, Traufhöhe and Firsthöhe from the LoD2 building model; the tallest reaches 38.9 m.

positive.prompt: What is the Bodenrichtwert at Am Mittelhafen 11, 48155 Münster, and show me an aerial image of the site.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the Bodenrichtwert of 595 €/m² with Stichtag 01.01.2026 and zone Hafen, and returns the official orthophoto of the site with its attribution.

positive.description: Data coverage for a German state
positive.prompt: Which data does Assetfy cover for Nordrhein-Westfalen?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the datasets held for Nordrhein-Westfalen — Liegenschaftskataster (Flurstücke, Gebäude, LoD2 heights, tatsächliche Nutzung), Bebauungspläne, Bodenrichtwerte and aerial images — and names any dataset that is not available.

negative.prompt: Who owns the plot at Am Mittelhafen 11, 48155 Münster? Give me the owner's name and phone number.
Delete all my saved places and favourites in Assetfy.
What is the land value of a plot at 10 Rue de Rivoli, Paris?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Access requires an Assetfy subscription that is booked on assetfy.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: parcel profile from the official cadastre, planning law with Bebauungsplan documents, buildings with eaves and ridge height, Bodenrichtwert, terrain, aerial images, 3D building models, site-plan export, property listings and the user's saved places and favourites.

de-DE.subtitle: Flurstück, B-Plan, Bodenwert
de-DE.description:
Standortprüfung & Grundstücksakquise für Makler, Projektentwickler, Bauträger, Architekten, Gutachter und institutionelle Investoren, die eine Immobilie kaufen oder bewerten möchten.

Grundstücke auf der Flurkarte, Bebauungsplan, Bodenrichtwert, GRZ/GFZ, Trauf- und Firsthöhe und Immobilien-Inserate für Deutschland in Ihrem KI-Assistenten.

Fragen Sie in normaler Sprache nach einem Flurstück, einer Adresse oder einem aktuellen Verkaufs-Exposé – die Antwort kommt aus den Flur- & Katasterdaten, den 3D-Gebäudemodellen (LoD2), Bodenrichtwerten, Luftbildern und Bebauungsplänen (falls verfügbar).

Was Assetfy liefert:
- Flurstück & Flurkarte: Gemarkung, Flur, Flurstücksnummer, Grundstücksgröße in m², Umrisse, Zuschnitt, Straßenfront & Lage
- Gebäude: Adresse, Gebäudefunktion, Geschosszahl, Gebäudehöhe, Traufhöhe, Firsthöhe, Dachform, Baujahr, Grundfläche
- Tatsächliche Nutzung / Grundstücksnutzung aus dem Kataster: z. B. Wohnbaufläche, Gewerbe- und Industriefläche, Lagerfläche, Landwirtschaft, Bahngelände
- Baurecht & indikative Ersteinschätzung der Bebaubarkeit: Bebauungsplan (B-Plan) mit Planunterlagen, §34/§35 BauGB, GRZ, GFZ, BGF (Bruttogeschossfläche), Nachverdichtungs- und Aufstockungspotenzial
- Bodenrichtwert und Grundstückswert (BORIS)
- Luftbild: amtliches Orthofoto (DOP20) zu jedem Standort
- Immobilienangebote: Grundstücke, Häuser, Wohnungen, Gewerbeobjekte und Zwangsversteigerungen
- Standortsuche für Gewerbe, Logistik, Rechenzentren, Batteriespeicher und Solarparks: nach Nutzung, Fläche, Bebauungsgrad, B-Plan und Autobahnnähe in einem Schritt (je nach Konto)

Nur lesend: Das Plugin legt nichts an und ändert nichts, weder in Assetfy noch in Ihrem Konto.

Zur Verbindung melden Sie sich mit Ihrem Assetfy-Konto an.
